name: qsr-timeline
features: Timeline view draws each restaurant chain as a bar by year with an ownership ribbon.
Search, sort by lifespan, year founded, name or category, and filter by category.
Views include lifespan, graveyard, snapshot, radial with a picked metric, and a US map.
Map shows HQ states, origin states, chain focus and expansion, with play to animate.
Tapping bars and ribbon segments shows details.
